name: Find My Rental Property
notes: Holds NSW Fair Trading real estate licence no. 20111067 (Licensee in Charge: Melissa Maimann). Licence number prominently published on firm's public website (findmyrentalproperty.com.au) and on mmba.com.au (sister Buyer's Agent brand under same licence).
